name: Cultivate Equivo through received player value
from: The source has deterministic FSRS-lite scheduling, checkers, mastery projection and browser-local export/import. Historical deployment notes concern iYappy; local mastery values are not validated learning outcomes or proof of the current Equivo release.
to: A learning game with corpus-authored lessons, checkable actions and a useful review schedule. The current cycle answers: Can a learner explain an error, apply the concept in a new prompt and return to the right review without losing progress? Its outcome changes the next product decision.
cost: Bounded allocated attention, existing available tools and received supplier capacity; no new spending, price, outreach or recurring obligation is introduced by this declaration.
otherwise: Preserve the full title promise and original Work; identify the dependent obstruction and complete independent design, content or source work that remains authorized.
receiver-condition: Compiler/checker/scheduler correctness plus actual lesson/transfer/recovery sessions. Learning evidence must use novel tasks and retain uncertainty; no fabricated efficacy claim. A distinct Public Games receiver checks evidence against the original player task; the producing worker does not self-receive by changing office labels.
